sensors.title: Sensors & devices
sensors.description: Grid sensor: positive = importing. PV/EV/house sensors feed the history DB and arbitrage. go-e IP: leave blank to disable EV control. Tibber + car-state: needed for solar/cheap EV charging. Solcast (remaining + detailed forecast): enables adaptive PV charging and arbitrage. Weather: outdoor temperature for the history DB.

economics.title: Battery economics & arbitrage
economics.description: Wear cost / round-trip efficiency blank = auto (derived / measured). Per-battery cost + expected cycles feed the wear cost; capacity auto-reads. Arbitrage control actuation is also toggled by the Arbitrage Control switch.

data.wear_cost_ct: Battery wear cost override (ct/kWh, blank = derived)

history.title: History database
history.description: 15-minute analytical DB, never purged by default. Retention 0 = keep forever. Path blank = <config>/wattsmith/history.db.
